cause.label: dilution_or_going_concern
cause.what_happened: This is day three of unwinding a float squeeze. On 09-22 the stock rose about 1,100% to $34.46 on an FDA PDUFA fee waiver for Mytesi, with only about 520k shares outstanding after the 1-for-15 split of 09-17, and fell 74% on 09-23. Before today's open the company filed two things: an 8-K at 06:01 ET disclosing 547,898 new shares issued to Streeterville on 09-23 for $5.05m of note (about 43% of the 1,281,867 shares outstanding), and a 424B5 at 09:22 ET resetting its Ladenburg ATM to $9.82m of capacity. That produced a -21.1% gap and a further -5.4% intraday, on 43.6x volume.

findings.finding: An ATM refreshed at 09:22 ET on 2026-09-24 gives Ladenburg $9.82m of capacity, about 115% of market cap at $6.65 on 1,281,867 shares. The issuer already sold about $4.69m through this program between 09-03 and 09-23, and it can keep selling through the 2026-09-25 session.
findings.mechanism_in_window: The supplement is effective on an S-3 shelf (333-278861, base prospectus 2024-05-01) and the sales agent is already engaged, so sales can print in the 09-25 session with no further filing. The issuer has just shown it draws the program aggressively into any strength, having sold about $4.69m in three weeks.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The last supply events in the baseline history, 09-08 (-30.65%) and 09-15 (-29.47%), each coincided with issuance 8-Ks and ATM filings. Next-day closes were -11.59% and +3.56%, and the full set of 24 comparable falls has a median of -5.94% with 20.8% up.
findings.why_not_priced: The gap priced the ANNOUNCEMENT of capacity. It did not price how much of that capacity is still unsold, because ATM fills are not disclosed until the next 10-Q, so the market cannot see whether today's roughly $12.8m of turnover absorbed the agent's sales. A price that held a finished seller would show the 09-25 open holding today's close without the persistent offer an agent working a program worth more than the market cap produces. Nothing makes today's sales visible before the close of the window.
findings.independence: The prior supplement (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1585608/000119312526381113/d126561d424b5.htm) shows the $4.69m sold this month. The 09-18 PRE 14A (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1585608/000119312526395715/d78419dpre14a.htm) asks for authority up to a 1-for-150 reverse split and a lower ELOC floor, so the company is still planning to raise more. Both are the issuer's own documents, not an independent source.

findings.finding: 547,898 shares, about 43% of shares outstanding, were issued to Streeterville on 2026-09-23 under a 3(a)(9) exchange at an effective $9.22, above today's $6.65. The 2025 note still has a balance, so another exchange could print the same way.
findings.mechanism_in_window: 3(a)(9) exchange shares tack the note's holding period (issued 2025-11-12, more than 10 months), so they can be sold now. The holder is an underwater convertible lender that has done three Series Q exchanges plus this one since July, and each new exchange is executed privately and disclosed after the fact, as today's 06:01 ET 8-K was.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 09-15 8-K disclosed 304,473 Streeterville exchange shares and 557,377 LAS exchange shares (pre-split). The baseline shows the 09-15 fall of -29.47% followed by a +3.56% next close, so this line has not always continued the next day.
findings.why_not_priced: Today's volume (about 1.8m shares, more than the whole share count) may already have absorbed much of this block, and nothing public says how much of it is left. The remaining note balance is not stated in the 8-K; original principal less this exchange is an upper bound, not a figure. That is why this is sized small: if the block were spent, 09-25 would trade without the overhang, and there is no way to verify that.
findings.independence: The 09-15 8-K (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1585608/000119312526391682/d162139d8k.htm) documents repeated Streeterville exchanges since July. It is the same issuer, so not independent.

outside_window.finding: Special meeting on 2026-10-23: a reverse split between 1-for-2 and 1-for-150, cutting the ELOC floor below $16.50 (which unlocks a second equity line; at $6.65 it is blocked by the floor inside the window), Series Q exchange issuance, repricing of legacy warrants to $1.00, and a Mailman warrant issuance under 5635(b)/(d)

Napo minority-interest purchase (closed 2026-09-15): 535,000 shares plus a pre-funded warrant for 2,077,255 shares (pre-split, about 35.7k and 138.5k post-split), issued under Reg D. Resale needs registration or Rule 144, so this is not window supply
